subsection.name: Unsuccessfull Logons
description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of unsuccessful logon attempts since the last successful logon

subsection.name: Successful and Unsuccessful Logons
description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of successful logons, unsuccessful logon attempts, both during organization-defined time period

subsection.name: Notification of Account Changes
description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of changes to organization-defined security-related characteristics or parameters of the user’s account during organization-defined time period

subsection.name: Additional Logon Information
description: Notify user, upon successful logon, of organization defined additional information
